correctness.rationale: Complete proof identifies all n rotation discontinuities and shows exactly one of the n adjacent lex transitions changes the last bit; the others are 01→10. For internal j the tortoise images merge iff the unchanged prefix has zero ones, or equivalently ceil(j alpha)=1. Irrationality makes these j exactly 1..min(n-1,floor(1/alpha)), with no non-adjacent extra collapse because images are nondecreasing. The proof handles all positive n, n=1, and n=0; finite checks independently support n<=100 at five algebraic slopes without replacing infinite proof.
